# serverguard24_host (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Serverguard24 host by `id` or `name`. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

~> **Performance:** The underlying `get_hosts` endpoint ignores the `id` filter and always returns the full account; the provider filters client-side. A 30s cache with mutex-serialization prevents redundant fetches. Remaining cost is local filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverguard24_host" "example" {
  name = "my-server.example.com"
}

output "host_address" {
  value = data.serverguard24_host.example.address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Host ID. Either `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Host name (alias). Either `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) IP address or FQDN of the host.
- `groups` (List of Number) List of group IDs the host is assigned to.
